clause_path: Section 23.4 -- freshness and consent (freshness_status: undeclared, stale, fresh)

obligations.label: entries may attach a freshness block describing how recent the attested value is, plus declarative statements of the consent and retention basis behind its collection
observed_at is required when freshness is present, and after expires_at a verifier must report the entry stale
freshness_class is required when freshness is present and takes one of the closed enum values realtime, intraday, daily, point-in-time, static
consent_ref is a SHA-256 digest of a consent artifact; presence is asserted only and the referenced artifact is out of profile
retention_class is declarative only and carries no enforcement machinery
freshness is hash-excluded: a freshness block never enters the execution hash preimage
the report grows a freshness_status field with three possible readings: undeclared for entries without a freshness block, stale once expires_at has passed, and fresh in every remaining case
a stale finding is informational only and overrides none of the other verdicts
gates in the section 21.4 machinery are allowed to key on the forwarded freshness_status field, and that is the only interaction; the gate machinery itself needs no change
